QuestionText: Senator DUNIAM: With the process of procurement, do you go and look at what the standard market rate is? Is that one of the considerations that the department has in its decision-making process for procurement? Mr Boyd: I don't know. We'd have to take that on notice and check.
_note: Taken on notice in the Official for Education and Employment Estimates 10 Oct 2025 (transcript 29001). Fixture metadata names the hearing.
